 Judgment

This appeal under Section 173(1) of the Indian Motor Vehicle Act is filed against the judgment and award dated 28.11.2018 passed by the Motor Vehicles Accident Claim Tribunal, Bengaluru in MVC No.408/2017.

entities.text: Motor Vehicles Accident Claim Tribunal, Bengaluru
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. Claimant having sustained accidental injuries filed a claim petition under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicle Act claiming just and proper compensation.

The Tribunal awarded a total compensation amount of Rs.16,25,750/.
3.
Heard the learned counsel for the appellant and the learned counsel for the respondent.
4. The claimant having sustained accidental injuries in a road traffic accident on 24.11.2016 is not disputed.
It is also not disputed that the claimant is a businessman by avocation and even after sustaining accidental injuries he continues to operate the business.
Therefore, the claimant is not entitled for compensation towards loss of future income.
5. The claimant was as an inpatient for nearly 50 days and in his evidence he has categorically stated he was earning a sum of Rs.40,000/- per month from his business.
The claimant suffered head injury, comminuted fracture femur shaft left, undisclosed fracture neck of femur left and fracture of both bone NC: 2024:KHC:21030 leg left side.

Therefore, the compensation awarded by the Tribunal is reassessed as follows:
Pain and suffering Rs.1,50,000/-
Conveyance, attended charges and nutrition food Rs.1,00,000/-
Loss of amenities and happiness Rs.1,00,000/-
Medical Expenses Rs.3,22,527/-
